news.title: Match report: Chelsea 0-2 Tottenham Hotspur
news.title_zh: 比赛战报：切尔西 0-2 托特纳姆热刺
news.body_en: It proved a disappointing evening for the Blues at Stamford Bridge as we were beaten by Tottenham Hotspur. For much of the contest, little separated the two sides. In the opening period, Cole Palmer and Jordan Henderson forced Antonin Kinsky into good saves. Mike Penders, meanwhile, produced good stops to deny Omar Marmoush and Mathys Tel. The second period remained tight, but with 13 minutes to play, a Tottenham corner ended up in the Blues' goal via the hand of Penders, who was put under pressure by Jan Paul van Hecke. Palmer was then shown a red card after receiving two yellows inside ten minutes, and Tel netted late on for Tottenham to condemn the Blues to defeat. Xabi Alonso was forced to make two changes to his starting XI. Emi Martinez and Joao Pedro both missed out due to injuries –the latter sustaining an issue in training yesterday – and were replaced by Penders and Geovany Quenda. The opening 45 minutes were played in a downpour. It meant every touch had to be precise and every pass weighted perfectly. The Blues looked more threatening in the early stages and kept Tottenham at arm's length. Our first chance of note was fashioned as the game approached the quarter-hour mark. Pedro Neto started it as he won the ball near the corner flag and fed it to Morgan Rogers inside the box. The England international laid it first-time to Palmer, who whipped his shot to the far post from an acute angle. However, Antonin Kinsky saved well. As the half progressed, Spurs took a stranglehold of possession. Mohammed Kudus had the visitors' first shot of the evening – an attempt from inside the box that flew wide – before a good chance was created for Omar Marmoush from 10 yards. Penders reacted quickly to produce an excellent stop. The Belgian goalkeeper produced an even better save soon after, rushing out and diving at the feet of Mathys Tel to deny the forward's left-footed strike. Alonso's side responded to the Spurs' attempts. The first came following a mistake from Kinsky, which enabled Neto, Rogers and Palmer to exchange one-touch passes in the Tottenham penalty area and lay the ball to Henderson. The Blues midfielder attempted to guide his finish into the corner, but put it close enough to Kinsky to allow the goalkeeper to save. Rogers was next denied as he drove a left-footed strike at goal, but the offside flag was subsequently raised. Our final chance of the half fell to Neto, with a free-kick worked short to the Portuguese winger. He drove his shot to the near post, yet Kinsky got down to save and the game was goalless at the interval. The Blues have often made fast starts to second halves this season, but both sides nullified each other's threat in 15 minutes after the break. Much of the game was played in midfield, with attacks breaking down or being snuffed out. It wasn't until the hour mark that a shot was registered that threatened to break the deadlock. It came from Neto, who, after winning the ball and finding Palmer, reacted quickest to a rebound inside the area and drove a shot at Kinsky. The Tottenham stopper beat it behind for a corner. Our first change of the afternoon came soon after, with Marco Palestra coming on for Hato. The Italian dropped into a role on the left of our defence. Estevao's introduction followed; he replaced Quenda. Before the Brazilian's introduction came the game's biggest flashpoint. After Caicedo launched a counter-attack and was fouled in the process by van de Ven, a run from Palmer was halted by Mateus Fernandes falling and grabbing the ball. Several players came together, and three yellow cards followed, one of which went to Palmer. From the restart, we fashioned an opportunity as Palmer and Henderson combined to get Estevao in on goal from a tight angle. He fired at goal but into the side netting. With 13 minutes to play, and somewhat against the run of play, Tottenham went ahead. A corner was delivered into the Chelsea penalty area and van Hecke put Penders under pressure. The ball struck the hand of the Blues goalkeeper and deflected into our net despite Maxence Lacroix's efforts. Our task got harder as, three minutes later, Palmer caught Conor Gallagher in midfield and referee Chris Kavanagh deemed it worthy of a second yellow card, and a red followed. The game was effectively killed late on as a run and finish from Tel gave Tottenham a two-goal advantage in the closing stages, which they were able to see out to claim victory. The Blues are back in action on Wednesday evening as we take on Liverpool in the fourth round of the Carabao Cup. news.body_zh: 事实证明，蓝军在斯坦福桥度过了一个令人失望的夜晚，我们被托特纳姆热刺队击败。在比赛的大部分时间里，双方几乎没有分出胜负。开局阶段，科尔·帕尔默和乔丹·亨德森迫使安东尼·金斯基进行了精彩扑救。与此同时，迈克·彭德斯（Mike Penders）做出了精彩的拦网，挡住了奥马尔·马穆什（Omar Marmoush）和马蒂斯·特尔（Mathys Tel）的进攻。第二节比赛形势依然胶着，但在比赛还剩 13 分钟时，托特纳姆热刺队的角球最终通过潘德斯的手射入蓝军球门，潘德斯受到扬·保罗·范赫克的压力。帕尔默在十分钟内吃到两张黄牌后被出示红牌，而特尔在最后时刻为热刺攻入一球，宣告蓝军惨败。哈维·阿隆索被迫对首发阵容做出两次调整。埃米·马丁内斯和若昂·佩德罗均因伤缺席——后者在昨天的训练中出现问题——并被彭德斯和乔瓦尼·昆达顶替。开场45分钟是在倾盆大雨中进行的。这意味着每次触球都必须精确，每次传球都必须完美。蓝军在比赛初期看起来更具威胁性，并与托特纳姆热刺保持一定的距离。当比赛临近一刻钟时，我们第一次获得关注的机会出现了。佩德罗·内托（Pedro Neto）在角旗附近赢得球并将球传给禁区内的摩根·罗杰斯（Morgan Rogers）。这位英格兰国脚将球传给了帕尔默，帕尔默以锐角将球射向远门柱。然而，安东尼·金斯基保存得很好。随着上半场的进行，热刺牢牢掌握了控球权。穆罕默德·库杜斯 (Mohammed Kudus) 为客队打出了当晚的第一脚射门——一次从禁区内射门，但飞出了底线——随后奥马尔·马尔穆什 (Omar Marmoush) 在 10 码外创造了一个好机会。彭德斯反应迅速，完成了出色的停球。比利时门将很快做出了更好的扑救，冲出并扑到马蒂斯·特尔脚下，挡出了前锋的左脚射门。阿隆索的球队回应了马刺队的尝试。第一个进球发生在金斯基的失误之后，内托、罗杰斯和帕尔默在托特纳姆禁区内交换一脚传球，并将球传给了亨德森。蓝军中场试图将射门射入角球，但球距离金斯基足够近，让门将扑救。罗杰斯随后左脚射门被挡出，但越位旗随后被举起。我们上半场的最后一次机会落在了内托身上，葡萄牙边锋的任意球没能成功。他射门近门柱，但金斯基倒地扑救，中场休息时比赛没有进球。本赛季蓝军经常在下半场快速开局，但双方在中场休息后15分钟内就化解了对方的威胁。比赛的大部分时间都是在中场进行，进攻被破坏或被压制。直到一小时后，才有可能打破僵局的一枪。球来自内托，他在赢得球并找到帕尔默后，对禁区内的篮板反应最快，并向金斯基射门。托特纳姆热刺队的门将在后面抢到了角球。下午的第一次换人很快就到来了，马科·帕莱斯特拉换下了哈托。意大利人在我们后防线的左边发挥了作用。接下来是埃斯特沃的介绍；他取代了昆达。在巴西人上场之前，比赛最大的亮点出现了。在凯塞多发起反击并被范德文犯规后，帕尔默的跑动被马特乌斯·费尔南德斯摔倒并抢断。几名球员凑在一起，三张黄牌随之而来，其中一张是帕尔默的。从比赛重新开始，我们创造了一次机会，帕尔默和亨德森联手从小角度帮助埃斯特沃射门。他向球门射门，但射入了边网。比赛还剩 13 分钟时，托特纳姆热刺队取得了领先，这在一定程度上违背了比赛的节奏。切尔西禁区开出角球，范赫克给彭德斯施压。尽管马克森斯·拉克鲁瓦 (Maxence Lacroix) 奋力拼搏，但球还是击中了蓝军门将的手并偏入了我们的球网。我们的任务变得更加艰巨，三分钟后，帕尔默在中场抓住了康纳·加拉格尔，裁判克里斯·卡瓦纳认为值得第二张黄牌，随后出示了一张红牌。比赛在最后阶段被终结，特尔的跑动和射门让托特纳姆热刺队在最后阶段取得了两球的优势，最终他们赢得了胜利。 周三晚上，蓝军将重返赛场，我们将在卡拉宝杯第四轮比赛中迎战利物浦。切尔西：彭德斯； Acheampong、Lacroix、Colwill、Hato（Palestra 65）；凯塞多 (c)、亨德森；内托 (维尔贝克 88)、帕尔默、昆达 (埃斯特瓦 72)；罗杰斯 切尔西替补：沙曼-洛、古斯托、福法纳、巴科、尼科尔-贾祖利、拉维亚黄牌：帕尔默 71、内托 79、罗杰斯 90+1 被罚下：帕尔默 80 托特纳姆热刺：金斯基；格雷、范赫克、范德文、罗伯逊（佩德罗波罗 65）；马特乌斯·费尔南德斯、托纳利； Kudus (Kulusevski 89)、Maddison (Gallagher 51)、Tel (Davies 89)；马穆什（索兰克 65）托特纳姆热刺替补：杜布拉夫卡、塞内西、奥卢塞西、威廉姆斯-巴内特进球者：彭德斯 77、电话 87 黄牌：加拉格尔 67、范德文 71、马特乌斯·费尔南德斯 72

news.title: Cesar Azpilicueta joins Chelsea Legends squad taking on Tottenham
news.title_zh: 塞萨尔·阿斯皮利奎塔加入切尔西传奇队迎战托特纳姆热刺
news.body_en: On the day the current Chelsea team play Spurs, another of our Champions League-winning captains is confirmed for when Stamford Bridge hosts a clash between old rivals on Saturday 27 March. The Chelsea Legends versus Tottenham Legends match will take place on Easter Weekend and raise crucial funds for Chelsea Foundation and its work bringing people together, creating healthier lives and shaping brighter futures in our local communities. Cesar Azpilicueta, the sixth-highest appearance-maker in our history who won every major trophy available to him while at Chelsea, joins another successful skipper, John Terry, plus Eden Hazard, Oscar and Chelsea Women's legendary captain Katie Chapman as the players announced so far. They will be stirring great memories when they return to Stamford Bridge next spring with more legends to be announced in the coming weeks. Tickets for the match, which kicks off at 3pm on 27 March, are on general sale. - Click to buy Chelsea Legends vs Tottenham Legends tickets Tickets for this match are priced as follows: Adults: £35 Juniors (under 20): £17.50 Under 23: £17.50 Seniors (66 or over): £17.50 Personal assistant: free of charge Tickets will be dispatched digitally to supporters – further details to follow. All persons under the age of 16 will be required to attend the relevant area of the ground with, and sit in the ground next to, a person aged 18 years of age or over. Season ticket holders, True Blue+, True Blue and CFC Blue members can purchase tickets in Westview. All Club Chelsea ticket purchases are subject to Club Chelsea terms and conditions. Accessible season ticket holders and members can purchase tickets as outlined above via the application form available by clicking here or by phoning the access team on 0371 811 2012 or 0044 207 915 1950 (international callers). Supporters can click here to make an application for car parking from 10am on Wednesday 3 March. You will be required to display your Blue Badge while parked at Stamford Bridge. There will be no ticket exchange in operation for this fixture. Supporters who have a Ticket Forwarding Membership can receive tickets from a season ticket holder or True Blue+, True Blue or CFC Blue member up until 12pm on Saturday 27 March. Supporters will receive zero loyalty points for this match. Please note refund requests must reach the ticket office no later than 3pm on Saturday 20 March. The match will also provide support for Spurs in the Community.

news.title: Alonso explains Joao Pedro absence plus Penders and Quenda selections against Tottenham
news.title_zh: 阿隆索解释若奥·佩德罗缺席以及对阵托特纳姆热刺的彭德斯和昆达的选择
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso has explained why Joao Pedro is not in the Chelsea squad for this afternoon’s game against Tottenham Hotspur – and emphasised the qualities Mike Penders and Geovany Quenda will bring on their full Premier League debuts. We are back at Stamford Bridge this afternoon for what the Blues manager expects to be an ‘intense game’ against our London rivals, whom we are aiming to defeat for an unprecedented seventh success in the Premier League. Alonso has made two changes to the team that started our win at Everton last weekend. One was expected as Penders replaces the injured Emi Martinez, who underwent jaw surgery after a nasty collision with Jarrad Branthwaite at the Hill Dickinson Stadium. The other is the absence of Joao Pedro, with Alonso explaining the Brazilian was ruled out of the contest yesterday. ‘He felt something yesterday in training,’ Alonso said. ‘At the moment, he has some fluid [around the injury], so we have to do some tests to see how big is the injury is. For sure, it’s a disappointment, but we need to carry on.’ Quenda is the man Alonso has opted to replace Joao Pedro with in the starting XI. It is the Portuguese winger’s first top-flight start in English football after his arrival in the summer. He has many qualities,’ Alonso said when asked about Quenda’s selection.’ He attacks the space well, is good with the ball, and is a threat. He’s been training well, and all the players will have their opportunities. Sometimes, they have to be more patient. Geo has been patient, and today it’s a big game to make his debut as a starter. 'We want to have mobility and to be fluid, so that we are not static and for sure with Geo we have those qualities.' Penders, meanwhile, starts in the Premier League for the first time, having made his debut off the bench against Everton last weekend. ‘I believe in every player we have and today it’s the first start in the PL for Mike,’ explained Alonso. ‘He showed last weekend against Everton that the can have a good impact. We need to deal with injuries and now he has a good chance, and we are fully confident.’ A big-game atmosphere is building at Stamford Bridge ahead of kick-off, and Alonso has highlighted the important role the Blues supporters play across the 90 minutes. 'It will be an intense game at a high tempo and high intensity on the pitch and in the stands. A proper derby. We expect an intense game with different moments for everything, with our qualities and the qualities of Tottenham. So it’s going to be very interesting.'
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索解释了为什么若昂·佩德罗没有出现在今天下午对阵托特纳姆热刺的切尔西大名单中，并强调了迈克·彭德斯和乔瓦尼·昆达将在他们的英超首秀中展现出的品质。今天下午我们回到斯坦福桥，蓝军主帅预计这将是一场对阵伦敦对手的“激烈比赛”，我们的目标是击败他们，在英超联赛中取得前所未有的第七次胜利。阿隆索对上周末我们在埃弗顿获胜的球队做出了两项调整。彭德斯接替受伤的埃米·马丁内斯（Emi Martinez），后者在希尔·迪金森体育场与贾拉德·布兰斯韦特（Jarrad Branthwaite）发生严重碰撞后接受了下颌手术，这在预料之中。另一个是若昂·佩德罗的缺席，阿隆索解释说巴西人昨天被排除在比赛之外。 “他昨天在训练中感受到了一些东西，”阿隆索说。 “目前，他（伤处）有一些液体，所以我们必须做一些测试，看看伤势有多大。”当然，这令人失望，但我们需要继续前进。”昆达是阿隆索选择取代若昂·佩德罗进入首发阵容的人。这是这位葡萄牙边锋自夏天抵达英格兰足球以来首次在顶级联赛首发。当被问及昆达的选择时，阿隆索说道：“他有很多品质。”他的进攻空间很好，控球能力很好，并且是一个威胁。他训练得很好，所有球员都会有机会。有时，他们必须更有耐心。吉奥一直很有耐心，今天这是一场重要的比赛，他将作为首发登场。 “我们希望具有流动性和流动性，这样我们就不会一成不变，而且可以肯定的是，Geo 具备这些品质。”与此同时，彭德斯在上周末对阵埃弗顿的比赛中替补登场，首次在英超联赛中首发。 “我相信我们拥有的每一位球员，今天这是迈克在英超联赛中的第一次首发，”阿隆索解释道。 “他在上周末对阵埃弗顿的比赛中证明了他可以产生良好的影响。我们需要处理伤病问题，现在他有一个很好的机会，我们充满信心。”开球前，斯坦福桥正在营造一种重要的比赛氛围，阿隆索强调了蓝军球迷在整个 90 分钟中所发挥的重要作用。 “这将是一场在球场上和看台上高节奏、高强度的激烈比赛。一场真正的德比。我们期待一场激烈的比赛，每一件事都有不同的时刻，我们的实力和托特纳姆热刺的实力。所以这将会非常有趣。

news.title: Confirmed Chelsea line up vs Tottenham
news.title_zh: 确认切尔西对阵托特纳姆热刺的阵容
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso has made two changes to his Chelsea side for this evening's Premier League meeting with Tottenham Hotspur at Stamford Bridge. After defeating Bournemouth and then Everton, the Blues are targeting a third consecutive top-flight win – and an unprecedented seventh in the Premier League over Spurs. One change to the Chelsea starting XI was always going to be required, with Emi Martinez sidelined after undergoing jaw surgery following our win at Everton. Mike Penders comes into the side for his first Premier League start, and Alonso has also made one further alteration. Josh Acheampong, Maxence Lacroix, Levi Colwill and Jorrel Hato all continue in what is expected to be a back four, while Moises Caicedo captains the side and partners Jordan Henderson in midfield. Pedro Neto, who netted twice last time out, starts once more in an attack that also includes Cole Palmer, Geovany Quenda and Morgan Rogers. Joao Pedro is not in the match-day squad. news.title: Under-18 Premier League report: Chelsea 4-1 Ipswich Town
news.title_zh: 18岁以下英超联赛报告：切尔西 4-1 伊普斯维奇
news.body_en: Chelsea Under-18s came from behind to secure an impressive 4-1 victory over Ipswich Town at Cobham in the Under-18 Premier League, with Jacob Dako scoring a brace and Jacob Hall and Heze Grimwade always in target. After dominating the opening exchanges, the Blues fell behind in the 17th minute as Joel Ladegbaye swept home following an Ipswich counter-attack. We reacted positively, pushing for the leveller and probing the Ipswich back line on various occasions. Unfortunately, we couldn't apply a finishing touch before the break and went into the half-time interval a goal behind. The Blues continued to push in the second period, and our efforts paid off in the 66th minute as Dako found the net. That broke Ipswich's resistance and Hall netted soon after to put us ahead. We held that advantage until the closing stages – and then extended it as Ipswich attempted to salvage a point. Dako completed his double before Grimwade netted an excellent free-kick in stoppage time to seal a 4-1 victory. The Blues controlled the opening 15 minutes, although we were unable to consistently threaten the visitors' goal. Jashayde Greenwood did force a save from Ipswich goalkeeper Edward Twyman and Dako fired over the crossbar. After 17 minutes, we were punished on the counter, with Callum Stewart playing the final pass across the face of goal to enable Ladegbaye to sweep home and make it 1-0. We had a chance to level almost immediately, as Twyman raced out to clear his lines and missed the ball. Grimwade chased and lunged towards the ball, aiming to poke it into an empty net, but Pedro Felicio was there first to spare the goalkeeper’s blushes. We continued to search for an equaliser throughout the rest of the half. Ibrahim Rabbaj came close as he drifted inside and received the ball, but his left-footed attempt went just wide of the far post. We remained a persistent threat down the right, and Isaac McGillvary played a give-and-go with Rabbaj before cutting a pass to Greenwood. The Blues striker’s first-time shot was just off target. Towards the end of the half, Isaac Badu fashioned a great opportunity to level. The Portuguese youth international wriggled through midfield and played the ball to Greenwood, who lined up the shot before opting to tee up Rabbaj instead. But his shot was blocked and remained a goal down at the break. After the interval, it was more of the same, with the Blues holding onto the ball for long spells. Dako had two good chances in quick succession but was unable to convert either. Substitute Gabriel Sambou created the first, as he crossed into the penalty area for Dako, but he didn’t get enough on his header to steer it goalwards. Moments later, Greenwood drove towards goal and shimmied inside before laying the ball off to the midfielder, whose shot was dragged just wide. He was eventually rewarded with a goal, though. Captain Dante Waite played the ball behind the Tractor Boys’ defence, and Dako was able to tuck his finish into the net for his fifth league goal of the campaign. The Blues were a lot more like ourselves after Dako’s goal and, after Sambou had came agonisingly with a shot cleared off the line by Felicio. we scored our second just four minutes later. Hall gave us the advantage as he quickest when Twyman spilled a Dako free kick to place the ball into the corner. Having taken the lead, the Blues were oozing with confidence in the latter stages, and we began getting far more shots on target. Ipswich showed more attacking intent once they had fallen behind, but our defence handled the onslaught superbly. Dako then completed his brace to make it 3-1 with a neat finish into the bottom corner. The visitors' best chance fell to Kyle Messenger, who seemed set to halve the deficit. Toby Bell’s initial save was very impressive but the ball fell into Messenger’s path; fortunately, Hall made a fantastic recovery run and block. Grimwade got in on the action with the final kick of the game, scoring from a set piece once again. The 16-year-old wrapped the free-kick into the top left corner to end the game in style. This victory means we remain top of the table on 21 points, having won seven matches and scoring 37 goals. The Blues also extended our perfect run to five games. Chelsea Under-18s are back on the road next week when we face West Ham United on Saturday 31 October. The game gets underway at 11am BST and supporters can watch the match live with a CFC+ subscription. news.body_zh: 在 18 岁以下英超联赛中，切尔西 18 岁以下队后来居上，在科巴姆以 4-1 击败伊普斯维奇镇，雅各布·达科梅开二度，雅各布·霍尔和赫泽·格里姆韦德始终进球。在控制了开场比赛后，蓝军在第 17 分钟就落后了，乔尔·拉德格巴耶 (Joel Ladegbaye) 在伊普斯维奇的反击中破门得分。我们做出了积极的反应，在不同的场合推动扳平比分并探查伊普斯维奇的后防线。不幸的是，我们未能在中场休息前完成最后一击，以一球落后的方式进入中场休息。蓝军在第二节继续推进，我们的努力在第 66 分钟得到了回报，达科破门得分。这打破了伊普斯维奇的抵抗，霍尔很快就进球帮助我们取得领先。我们一直保持着这一优势，直到最后阶段，然后随着伊普斯维奇试图挽救一分，我们扩大了优势。达科完成梅开二度，格里姆韦德在补时阶段打进一脚精彩的任意球，帮助球队4-1获胜。蓝军控制了开场 15 分钟，尽管我们无法持续威胁客队的球门。贾沙德·格林伍德迫使伊普斯维奇门将爱德华·特威曼做出扑救，达科的射门高出横梁。第 17 分钟，我们在反击中受到惩罚，卡勒姆·斯图尔特 (Callum Stewart) 的最后一脚传球穿过球门，拉德巴耶 (Ladegbaye) 破门得分，1-0。我们几乎有机会立即扳平比分，但特威曼冲出去清理他的防线，却错过了球。格里姆韦德追赶皮球，打算将球射入空门，但佩德罗·费利西奥率先赶到，避免了守门员的脸红。在下半场剩下的时间里，我们继续寻找扳平比分的机会。易卜拉欣·拉巴伊 (Ibrahim Rabbaj) 内线接球时差点就到了，但他的左脚射门稍稍偏出远门柱。我们在右路仍然是一个持续的威胁，艾萨克·麦吉尔瓦里（Isaac McGillvary）与拉巴杰（Rabbaj）进行了一次传球，然后将球传给了格林伍德（Greenwood）。蓝军前锋的第一次射门刚刚偏离目标。半场结束时，艾萨克·巴杜创造了一次扳平比分的绝佳机会。这位葡萄牙青年国脚在中场蠕动，将球传给格林伍德，格林伍德将球对准，然后选择为拉巴伊发球。但他的射门被封堵，在中场休息时仍落后一球。中场休息后，情况基本相同，蓝军长时间控球。达科连续两次获得好机会，但都未能转化。替补球员加布里埃尔·桑布 (Gabriel Sambou) 创造了第一个进球，他传中达科的禁区，但他的头球攻门不够，未能将球射向球门。过了一会儿，格林伍德冲向球门，在内线晃动，然后将球传给中场球员，后者的射门稍稍偏出。不过，他最终还是收获了进球。队长丹特·韦特（Dante Waite）在拖拉机男孩队的防守后面打球，达科（Dako）将球射入球网，这是他本赛季的第五个联赛进球。在达科进球之后，在桑布痛苦地射门被费利西奥挡出底线之后，蓝军变得更像我们了。仅仅四分钟后我们就取得了第二个进球。当特威曼传出达科任意球将球送入角球时，霍尔为我们带来了优势，因为他速度最快。取得领先后，蓝军在后期充满了信心，我们开始获得更多的射正机会。伊普斯维奇在落后时表现出了更多的进攻意图，但我们的防守很好地应对了进攻。达科随后完成梅开二度，将比分改写为3-1，并漂亮地射入底角。客队最好的机会落到了凯尔·梅辛杰身上，他似乎将把比分差距缩小一半。托比·贝尔（Toby Bell）最初的扑救令人印象深刻，但皮球落入了梅塞辛斯（Messenger）的路径中；幸运的是，霍尔做出了出色的恢复跑动和拦网。格里姆韦德在比赛最后一脚发挥出色，再次定位球得分。这位16岁的球员将任意球打入左上角，以优雅的方式结束了比赛。这场胜利意味着我们以 21 分继续排名榜首，赢得了 7 场比赛并攻入 37 个进球。蓝军还将我们的完美连胜延续到了五场比赛。切尔西 18 岁以下青年队将于下周重返客场，届时我们将在 10 月 31 日星期六对阵西汉姆联队。比赛于英国夏令时上午 11 点开始，支持者可以通过 CFC+ 订阅观看比赛直播。 切尔西（4-3-3）：托比·贝尔； Dante Waite (中)、Jacob Hall、Calvin Diakite、Yisa Alao (Gabriel Sambou 45)；艾萨克·巴杜、雅各布·达科、艾萨克·麦吉尔瓦里（安德鲁·彭尼 62’）；易卜拉欣·拉巴伊、贾沙伊德·格林伍德、赫泽·格里姆韦德未上场替补：伊曼纽尔·阿因德、伊萨戈·席尔瓦、杰登·马伦达马、比拉尔·沙赫-贝尔库兹、夸米纳·安帕得分：雅各布·达科 66’、雅各布·霍尔 70’黄牌：但丁·维特 39’、加布里埃尔·桑布 53’、易卜拉欣·拉巴吉 78’ news.title: Alonso: We knew Lacroix's impact would be instant

news.body_en: Xabi Alonso believes Maxence Lacroix’s leadership and competitive nature have helped the centre-back quickly become an important member of his Chelsea team. Lacroix joined the Blues in the summer from fellow Londoners Crystal Palace after returning from the FIFA World Cup, where he was part of the France squad that reached the semi-finals. The defender has needed little time to adjust to his new surroundings across the capital and has become a central figure in Alonso’s plans, featuring in all our league fixtures so far this season – and starting all but one. A massive game is up next for the Blues, as Tottenham Hotspur visit Stamford Bridge this evening for a London derby that always gets the blood pumping in SW6. And ahead of that game, our manager discussed Lacroix’s strong start to life at Chelsea. Alonso said: ‘Max has many good things, but two of them are that he's ready – we knew that his impact was going to be instant with his Premier League experience, being competitive – and he has a strong personality. ‘He has great leadership. He likes to communicate, to be loud, to be very active in the game, and that presence is very important. ‘With the players around him, we are connecting better with him, and he's doing much better. He's doing good now, lately playing with Levi [Colwill] and when he has played with Wes [Fofana]. ‘We are very happy with him and he's feeling good.’ Don't miss your chance to experience the London derby in VIP style. news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索相信马克森斯·拉克鲁瓦的领导能力和竞争天性帮助这位中后卫迅速成为切尔西队的重要成员。拉克鲁瓦在世界杯归来后于今年夏天从伦敦同胞水晶宫加盟蓝军，他随法国队进入了半决赛。这名后卫几乎不需要时间来适应首都的新环境，并已成为阿隆索计划中的核心人物，在本赛季迄今为止的所有联赛比赛中都有出场，并且除了一场之外都首发。蓝军接下来将迎来一场重要的比赛，托特纳姆热刺今晚将造访斯坦福桥，参加一场在 SW6 中总是令人热血沸腾的伦敦德比。在那场比赛之前，我们的主教练讨论了拉克鲁瓦在切尔西的强劲开局。阿隆索说：“马克斯有很多优点，但其中有两点是他已经准备好了——我们知道他的影响力会随着他的英超经验和竞争力而立竿见影——而且他有很强的个性。” ‘他具有出色的领导能力。他喜欢交流，喜欢大声说话，在比赛中非常活跃，这种存在感非常重要。 “有了他身边的球员，我们与他的联系就更好了，他也做得更好了。他现在表现不错，最近和利维[科尔威尔]一起打球，还有和韦斯[福法纳]一起打球。 “我们对他感到非常满意，他感觉很好。” 不要错过以 VIP 方式体验伦敦德比的机会。切尔西俱乐部门票数量有限——立即预订即可在桥上购买。

news.title: Alonso on harnessing passion and energy of ‘electric’ derby atmosphere
news.title_zh: 阿隆索谈如何利用“电动”德比氛围的激情和能量
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso expects Chelsea supporters to create an 'electric' atmosphere inside Stamford Bridge during today's game against Tottenham Hotspur, which he believes will show the Premier League at its very best. Few occasions get Stamford Bridge bouncing quite like the visit of London rivals Tottenham to SW6; it's one of the first fixtures Blues supporters look out for when the Premier League fixtures are released each season. This match will be no different, with Alonso's side going into tomorrow's game in good form after back-to-back wins over Bournemouth and Everton. We are also looking for a club-record seventh consecutive home league victory over Spurs. Alonso is set to experience the atmosphere of a Chelsea versus Tottenham derby for the first time as Blues manager. But he knows what to expect and hopes the energy provided by the crowd can help his players to victory. ‘We are expecting a good atmosphere,’ he said. ‘Electric, with good energy, knowing that in a derby this passion is really in the air in the stadium. ‘We need to use it in a proper way because this is all about those games when you feel that excitement is something that you need. You don't need extra motivation; that will come naturally because of the history of the derby and because this is a top game. ‘We need that connection with the crowd in good moments. There will be tough moments, but we need to pull together and play our game. For me, it's fundamental that we play our game on the pitch. ‘The players, they do their best, but when the crowd is playing the game, is living it, that's the good thing about the Premier League. I think the crowd plays the game as well. It's not that they just watch the game. ‘They have great influence. When I say that spontaneously some energy is created in this league, it's because they feel that moment that: “Yes, I like what I see” and it's a big boost for the team.’ However, the Chelsea manager is aware that such emotionally charged atmospheres also require the players on the pitch to keep a level head to balance the passion with maturity, admitting that managing such situations in the Premier League is always a challenge mentally, but especially on occasions such as this. ‘It is very difficult,’ added Alonso. ‘That's why I've mentioned a few times that to find total dominance, a game when you are in full control and that you have no problems like in other leagues, it's difficult to find that in the Premier League unless you have become a top, top team. ‘That's why you can't rest when you are 2-0 up, because you know that if you concede one, the energy is coming, and you need to control that momentum. You can have mental preparation, but you need composure to deal with those moments. ‘I think that even in the Everton first half, we were 0-0, but there were a few [challenging] moments – 10 minutes of corner, throw-in, corner, throw-in. To go through those moments and to say, “Be calm guys, we know what we have to do, we have prepared for this and the other momentum will come”, for me it's fundamental.’ Don't miss your chance to experience the London derby in VIP style. news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索希望切尔西球迷在今天对阵托特纳姆热刺队的比赛中在斯坦福桥内营造出一种“激动人心”的氛围，他相信这将展现英超联赛的最佳状态。很少有机会能像伦敦对手托特纳姆热刺队造访 SW6 那样让斯坦福桥球场如此激动人心。这是每个赛季英超联赛赛程发布时蓝军球迷最先关注的比赛之一。这场比赛也不会有什么不同，阿隆索的球队在连续战胜伯恩茅斯和埃弗顿后，将以良好的状态进入明天的比赛。我们还希望创造俱乐部主场联赛连续第七次战胜热刺的纪录。阿隆索将作为蓝军主教练首次体验切尔西对阵托特纳姆热刺德比的气氛。但他知道会发生什么，并希望观众提供的能量能够帮助他的球员取得胜利。 “我们期待着良好的气氛，”他说。 “充满活力，充满活力，知道在德比中体育场的空气中确实弥漫着这种激情。 “我们需要以正确的方式使用它，因为当你觉得兴奋是你需要的东西时，这都是关于那些游戏的。你不需要额外的动力；由于德比的历史以及这是一场顶级比赛，这会很自然地发生。 “在美好的时刻，我们需要与人群建立联系。会有艰难的时刻，但我们需要齐心协力，打好自己的比赛。对我来说，我们在球场上踢球是至关重要的。 “球员们竭尽全力，但当观众参与比赛、享受比赛时，这就是英超联赛的好处。我认为人群也玩这个游戏。并不是说他们只是看比赛。 ‘他们有很大的影响力。当我说这个联赛自发地产生了一些能量时，是因为他们在那一刻感觉到：“是的，我喜欢我所看到的”，这对球队来说是一个巨大的推动。然而，切尔西主教练意识到，这种情绪激动的气氛也需要球场上的球员保持冷静，平衡激情与成熟，他承认在英超联赛中处理这种情况始终是一个精神上的挑战，尤其是在这样的场合。 “这非常困难，”阿隆索补充道。 “这就是为什么我多次提到，要找到完全的统治力，一场你完全控制的比赛，并且你没有像其他联赛那样的问题，在英超联赛中很难找到这种统治力，除非你已经成为一支顶级球队。” “这就是为什么当你2-0领先时你不能休息，因为你知道如果你丢球，能量就会到来，你需要控制这种势头。你可以做好心理准备，但你需要冷静地应对这些时刻。 “我认为即使是在埃弗顿上半场，我们还是0-0，但也有一些[具有挑战性的]时刻——10分钟的角球、界外球、角球、界外球。经历这些时刻并说，“保持冷静，伙计们，我们知道我们必须做什么，我们已经为此做好了准备，其他动力将会到来”，对我来说这是至关重要的。’不要错过以 VIP 方式体验伦敦德比的机会。切尔西俱乐部门票数量有限——立即预订即可在桥上购买。

news.title: Chelsea vs Tottenham: All you need to know
news.title_zh: 切尔西 vs 托特纳姆热刺：你需要知道的一切
news.body_en: High-flying Chelsea return to the house of fun for a 5.30pm Saturday kick-off against Tottenham Hotspur in the Premier League at Stamford Bridge. Club historian Rick Glanvill and club statistician Paul Dutton look ahead to derby day in west London. Over the coming weekends Chelsea host successive league games against traditional foes before the next international break and they do not come weightier than this cross-city clash of west and north. It is the Blues’ first game this season in a time-slot that has not recently been fruitful, with just seven points taken from the last possible 21 and a current run of two straight losses. However, we are undefeated in the past eight London derbies home and away played at this time, including a 1-0 defeat of our capital rivals in the reverse fixture last season. Roberto De Zerbi’s visitors were winless in all top-flight games this season until beating Frank Lampard’s Coventry City 3-1 at home on Monday, climbing out of the relegation zone as a result. Xabi Alonso’s Blues made what felt like a step forward with Saturday’s 2-0 victory at bogey side Everton and returned to the UEFA Champions League qualification places. Chelsea have taken the lead in six of our seven league outings to date – the complete opposite to Spurs – and have taken an average of just four minutes to open the scoring at the Bridge. Last May, the corresponding fixture ended 2-1 with Enzo Fernandez and Andrey Santos netting for the hosts to extend Spurs’ relegation reckoning to the final day. Chelsea have a remarkable home record against our second-oldest top-flight capital rivals and can make club history by beating the Cockerels an unprecedented seventh time in a row in the Premier League. Up to now, the Blues have beaten the Lilywhites 83 times across all competitions, more than any other opponent. Alonso confirmed in his pre-match press conference after Friday's training session that Malo Gusto was fit to return against Tottenham, having missed our win at Everton the previous weekend, but Pep Chavarria, Jamie Gittens and Emiliano Martinez remain unavailable. 'Malo is fine,' the Blues manager explained. 'Pep is training a little bit more, but he is not going to make it [for the Tottenham game]. 'Emi had the surgery and day-by-day he is feeling better, but we still need to wait. A few weeks. Hopefully, less than more, but we need to wait.' Emmanuel Emegha will also miss out. The striker has yet to feature since arriving this summer, but is making progress in his comeback. ‘He’s feeling better, but we need to wait,' said Alonso. Chelsea are undefeated in eight league derbies with this kick-off time, since Boxing Day 2020, winning seven, including at Tottenham a year ago at the Bridge through Joao Pedro’s stealthy finish. Down the Thames at Craven Cottage in mid-January 2021, Mason Mount settled the result late on, and some time after Antonee Robinson had been red carded. Four months later in the return against Fulham at the Bridge, Kai Havertz struck twice without reply to claim all the points in the west London derby. The German also drew early first blood at Crystal Palace in April, with Christian Pulisic quickly making it two inside 10 minutes. Kurt Zouma added a third for the visitors before Christian Benteke pulled one back for the shell-shocked hosts. Pulisic’s second made the last quarter-hour comfortable and it finished 4-1 to Chelsea. Two weeks later, at West Ham United’s London Stadium, Timo Werner netted the only goal of the game in the first half, Fabian Balbuema’s 81st-minute dismissal easing any nerves. At Brentford in October 2021, with fans back in the stadium, Ben Chilwell was the only name on the scoresheet, on the brink of half-time, with our only shot on target as Edouard Mendy kept the Bees at bay for Thomas Tuchel. A year ago at the Bridge, against this weekend’s visitors, with early fireworks fizzing the night sky, Moises Caicedo pounced on defensive uncertainty to set up Joao Pedro for the 1-0 winner. At the end of January 2026, Jarrod Bowen curled in West Ham’s opener in west London and Crysencio Summerville doubled their shock lead before the break. But Nuno Espírito Santo’s side were taken to task in the second half, with Joao Pedro’s close-range header halving the deficit before Marc Cucurella’s brave dive produced the leveller. Joao Pedro turned provider for Fernandez to drive in what proved the decisive finish, after which Anthony Taylor resolved a stoppage-time fracas with a red card for visiting defender Jean-Clair Todibo. Tottenham are Morgan Rogers’ favourite opponent, the Chelsea forward scoring a career-high four times against the Lilywhites. The Blues have won 55.7 per cent of ground duels – the most in this season’s top flight. Chelsea have now scored three goals in the opening minute of a half in the Premier League to date, our joint-most in a single campaign (alongside the entire 2011/12 season). Until last Saturday at Everton, Chelsea had not kept a clean sheet in the Premier League since the same 2-0 scoreline at home to Brentford on 17 January, 22 games ago. Pedro Neto had never previously scored twice in a Premier League game, though he had netted a hat-trick for the Blues against Hull City in the FA Cup. Don't miss your chance to experience the London derby in VIP style. Limited Club Chelsea tickets remain – book now to be at the Bridge.
news.body_zh: 雄心勃勃的切尔西重返欢乐之家，参加周六下午 5 点 30 分在斯坦福桥举行的英超联赛对阵托特纳姆热刺队的比赛。俱乐部历史学家里克·格兰维尔和俱乐部统计学家保罗·达顿展望伦敦西部的德比日。在接下来的周末，切尔西将在下一次国际比赛日之前连续对阵传统对手的联赛，他们的分量不会比这场西部和北部的跨城市冲突更重要。这是蓝军本赛季第一场比赛，在最近一段时间里并没有取得什么成果，在最后可能的21分中只拿下7分，并且目前已经连续两场失利。然而，我们在过去八场主客场伦敦德比中保持不败，包括上赛季在反向比赛中以 1-0 击败我们的首都对手。罗伯托·德泽尔比的客队本赛季在所有顶级联赛中均未尝一胜，直到周一主场3-1击败弗兰克·兰帕德的考文垂城，从而摆脱降级区。周六，哈维·阿隆索的蓝军以 2-0 战胜柏忌球队埃弗顿，感觉又向前迈进了一步，重返欧冠资格赛。迄今为止，切尔西在我们的七场联赛中有六场取得领先——这与热刺完全相反——并且平均只用了四分钟就在蓝桥首开纪录。去年5月，相应的比赛以2-1结束，恩佐·费尔南德斯和安德烈·桑托斯为东道主进球，将热刺的降级期延长到最后一天。切尔西在对阵我们第二古老的顶级联赛首都对手时拥有出色的主场战绩，并且可以在英超联赛中史无前例地连续第七次击败公鸡队，从而创造俱乐部历史。截至目前，蓝军在各项赛事中已经击败白百合队83次，超过任何其他对手。阿隆索在周五训练结束后的赛前新闻发布会上证实，马洛·古斯托在上周末错过了对阵埃弗顿的比赛后能够重返对阵托特纳姆热刺的比赛，但佩普·查瓦里亚、杰米·吉滕斯和埃米利亚诺·马丁内斯仍然无法上场。 “马洛很好，”蓝军主帅解释道。 “佩普正在进行更多的训练，但他不会（参加托特纳姆热刺队的比赛）。 “艾米接受了手术，他感觉一天天好起来，但我们仍然需要等待。几个星期。希望是少而不是多，但我们需要等待。伊曼纽尔·埃梅加也将错过。自从今年夏天加盟以来，这位前锋还没有出场过，但他的复出正在取得进展。 “他感觉好多了，但我们需要等待，”阿隆索说。自 2020 年节礼日以来，切尔西在开赛期间在八场联赛德比中保持不败，赢得了七场胜利，其中包括一年前在蓝桥对阵托特纳姆热刺时凭借若奥·佩德罗的隐形进球。 2021 年 1 月中旬，在泰晤士河畔的克雷文小屋，梅森·芒特在晚些时候，也就是在安东尼·罗宾逊被红牌罚下一段时间后，确定了比赛结果。四个月后，在蓝桥对阵富勒姆的比赛中，凯·哈弗茨梅开二度，在西伦敦德比中全取积分。德国人还在四月份的水晶宫比赛中早早取得了首个进球，克里斯蒂安·普利西奇在 10 分钟内迅速梅开二度。库尔特·祖玛 (Kurt Zouma) 为客队攻入第三球，而克里斯蒂安·本特克 (Christian Benteke) 则为饱受炮弹袭击的东道主队扳回一球。普利西奇的第二个进球让比赛最后一刻变得轻松，最终切尔西 4-1 获胜。两周后，在西汉姆联队的伦敦体育场，蒂莫·维尔纳在上半场打进了比赛的唯一进球，法比安·巴尔布埃马在第 81 分钟的下场缓解了紧张情绪。 2021 年 10 月在布伦特福德，球迷们回到了球场，本·奇尔韦尔是进球表上唯一的名字，在半场结束前，爱德华·门迪为托马斯·图赫尔挡住了蜜蜂队，这是我们唯一的射门。一年前，在蓝桥对阵本周末的客队时，夜空中早早燃放烟花，莫伊塞斯·凯塞多抓住了防守的不确定性，助攻若昂·佩德罗以 1-0 获胜。 2026 年 1 月下旬，贾罗德·鲍文 (Jarrod Bowen) 在西汉姆联队在伦敦西部的揭幕战中打进一球，克里森西奥·萨默维尔 (Crysencio Summerville) 在中场休息前将领先优势扩大了一倍。但努诺·圣埃斯皮里托·桑托的球队在下半场遇到了麻烦，若昂·佩德罗的近距离头球将比分差距减半，随后马克·库库雷拉的勇敢跳水将比分扳平。 若昂·佩德罗为费尔南德斯提供了帮助，最终完成了决定性的进球，随后安东尼·泰勒为客队后卫让·克莱尔·托迪博出示红牌，化解了伤停补时阶段的争吵。托特纳姆热刺是摩根·罗杰斯最喜欢的对手，这位切尔西前锋在对阵白百合队的比赛中四次得分创职业生涯新高。蓝军在地面对决中获胜率为 55.7%，是本赛季顶级联赛中获胜率最高的。迄今为止，切尔西在英超联赛中在半场开场一分钟就打进了三个进球，这是我们单赛季进球数最多的球队（以及整个 2011/12 赛季）。直到上周六对阵埃弗顿的比赛之前，切尔西自22场比赛前1月17日主场2-0布伦特福德以来在英超联赛中还没有保持过零失球。佩德罗·内托此前从未在英超联赛中梅开二度，尽管他在足总杯对阵赫尔城的比赛中为蓝军上演了帽子戏法。不要错过以 VIP 方式体验伦敦德比的机会。切尔西俱乐部门票数量有限——立即预订即可在桥上购买。

news.title: Loan switch for Shaun Wade
news.title_zh: 肖恩·韦德的租借转换
news.body_en: Chelsea Academy winger Shaun Wade has completed a loan move to Dulwich Hamlet. Wade has represented Chelsea in the Under-18s and Cobham Next Gen and will now continue his development in south London. Dulwich play in the Isthmian Premier Division, with Wade set to join his Blues team-mate Hudson Sands there. We wish Shaun well and look forward to monitoring his development at Dulwich.
news.body_zh: 切尔西青训边锋肖恩·韦德已完成租借至德威哈姆雷特。韦德曾代表切尔西参加 18 岁以下青年队和科巴姆下一代队，现在将在伦敦南部继续他的发展。德威队效力于伊斯米亚超级联赛，韦德将与他的蓝军队友哈德逊金沙队一起在那里踢球。我们祝愿肖恩一切顺利，并期待关注他在德威的发展。

news.title: Lacroix shares his journey from village life to the bright lights of the Bridge
news.title_zh: 拉克鲁瓦分享了他从乡村生活到桥上明亮灯光的旅程
news.body_en: Maxence Lacroix discusses his untypical footballing origins, in a farming village in the Dordogne region, and reveals his cultural hinterland in a wide-ranging interview for the matchday programme for Saturday’s Premier League game against Tottenham Hotspur. The France international defender grew up as one of a handful of kids playing football in the surrounding villages, where his parents both worked in the medical profession, and has risen to become a serial winner. 'It’s a farming village and there were maybe 300 people, with maybe five young children, because there were a lot of older people, or people who worked on the farms. My mother is a doctor, a general practitioner. And my father, he is working as a resuscitation nurse in the hospital. 'When I was young, I was quite close to wanting to be a vet, because animals were always close to me, you know. 'I started playing football at four. I was a goalkeeper, because my father was a goalkeeper. He put me on the field, because he loved football – he still does – and he said to me: "Okay, now it’s the time for you to start playing too".' The rest, as they say, is history, and now the 26-year-old is enjoying a year to remember, having gone to the FIFA World Cup off the back of a UEFA Conference League triumph with his former club Crystal Palace, then returned to London to begin the next chapter of his career with Chelsea. 'It’s going good,' he says of the season so far. 'I think we are in a better way, and you know, it was really quick for me, because I just left the national team, I had just a little bit of holidays and then I came back directly to playing the first game. So no, it was strange, but now I feel really settled in the team, so this is really good for me. 'It is fun, and it is a big team, you know – the players here are the best in the league. So I’m really happy to represent the badge and to be part of this big journey.' Elsewhere in the programme, club historian Rick Glanvill reflects on the impact Matthew Harding made on the club, as we mark the 30th anniversary of his tragic death in a helicopter crash on the way back from an away game at Bolton Wanderers in October 1996. The team that Harding’s investment helped to build went on to become one of the most cherished in Chelsea history, and their 6-1 win at White Hart Lane in December 1997 is the focus of our Greatest Games feature. Then there is all the info you need on the game ahead, plus the latest from around the club, including columns from Xabi Alonso and Reece James. So be sure to pick up your copy from the programme sellers around Stamford Bridge or order online from our publications partner, Reach Sport.
news.body_zh: 马克森斯·拉克鲁瓦 (Maxence Lacroix) 在周六英超联赛对阵托特纳姆热刺队的比赛日节目中接受了广泛的采访，讨论了他在多尔多涅地区的一个农村的非典型足球起源，并透露了他的文化腹地。这位法国国脚后卫是周围村庄里少数几个踢足球的孩子之一，他的父母都在当地从事医疗行业，并已成为连续的胜利者。 “这是一个农庄，大约有 300 人，可能有 5 个小孩，因为有很多老年人，或者在农场工作的人。我的母亲是一名医生，一名全科医生。我的父亲在医院担任复苏护士。 “当我年轻的时候，我非常想成为一名兽医，因为动物总是离我很近，你知道。 “我四岁开始踢足球。我是一名守门员，因为我父亲是一名守门员。他让我上场，因为他热爱足球——他仍然如此——他对我说：“好吧，现在你也开始踢球了”。正如他们所说，剩下的都是历史了，现在这位 26 岁的球员正在享受令人难忘的一年，他在欧洲足联会议联赛中与他的前俱乐部水晶宫取得胜利后前往国际足联世界杯，然后返回伦敦，在切尔西开始了他职业生涯的下一个篇章。 “进展顺利，”他谈到本赛季到目前为止的情况时说道。 “我认为我们处于更好的状态，你知道，这对我来说真的很快，因为我刚刚离开国家队，我只有一点假期，然后我就直接回来参加第一场比赛。所以不，这很奇怪，但现在我感觉自己真正融入了球队，所以这对我来说真的很好。 “这很有趣，而且这是一支大球队，你知道——这里的球员是联盟中最好的。所以我真的很高兴能够代表徽章并成为这一伟大旅程的一部分。”在节目的其他地方，俱乐部历史学家里克·格兰维尔反思了马修·哈丁对俱乐部的影响，我们正在纪念他在 1996 年 10 月客场对阵博尔顿队的比赛回来途中因直升机失事不幸身亡 30 周年。哈丁投资帮助建立的球队后来成为切尔西历史上最珍贵的球队之一，他们 1997 年 12 月在白鹿巷球场 6-1 的胜利是我们的焦点最伟大的游戏功能。然后是您需要的有关即将到来的比赛的所有信息，以及俱乐部的最新信息，包括 Xabi Alonso 和 Reece James 的专栏。因此，请务必从斯坦福桥周边的节目销售商处获取您的副本，或从我们的出版物合作伙伴 Reach Sport 在线订购。

news.title: Tottenham game travel warning - Fulham Broadway closed; District Line disruption
news.title_zh: 托特纳姆热刺比赛旅行警告 - 富勒姆百老汇关闭；区线中断
news.body_en: Supporters intending to travel to or from Saturday’s home Premier League game against Tottenham Hotspur using the London Underground are advised that planned engineering works may affect your journey. The District Line is closed west of Embankment Station and on the whole of the Edgware Road branch, including the line down to Wimbledon. This means for the match at Stamford Bridge, Fulham Broadway Station is closed all day and there are no District Line trains running to any nearby stations on that branch of the tube network. The Circle Line is also affected and is closed between Edgware Road and Aldgate (via Victoria). The Mildmay Line is affected too from 7.30pm on Saturday, with no service between Shepherd's Bush and Willesden Junction. There will also be a reduced service between Shepherd's Bush and Clapham Junction. news.body_en: Ahead of Saturday’s match at Stamford Bridge, we have information to share regarding  Live Facial Recognition being used by the Metropolitan Police in the local area as well as expectations and measures regarding fan behaviour. The Metropolitan Police Service (MPS) has informed the club that on Saturday, Live Facial Recognition (LFR) will be deployed during the policing operation for the Chelsea versus Tottenham fixture.  The deployment follows the established stakeholder engagement approach previously used for football-related LFR deployments.  The two locations will be Earl's Court and West Brompton and two LFR vans will be deployed across these locations before the game. Signage will be deployed outside the zone of recognition in line with MPS LFR policy. The watchlist will contain individuals subject to Football Banning Orders relating to either club, together with persons wanted or missing for serious offences and those sought on warrants issued by HMCTS. The derby against Tottenham Hotspur is always one of our most anticipated games of the season and we are expecting nothing less than a passionate and vibrant atmosphere as we take on big London rivals. We welcome the part our supporters play in getting behind the team as the players target three wins in a row and victory in the first home London derby of the season.  We would like to remind supporters of their responsibilities in keeping support positive and ensuring that Stamford Bridge is a welcoming environment for all.   Discriminatory actions or language such as antisemitic or sectarian chanting have no place anywhere in football or society, and Chelsea is a club that actively celebrates our diversity. There are measures in place and strong sanctions against offenders to tackle discriminatory, anti-social and criminal behaviour. This could include suspension from attending all Chelsea matches, as well as potential police action. If you witness any anti-social or discriminatory behaviour on matchday, please report it to us.  Click below to use our reporting form for home matchdays.  This link will be active and the form available for use from three hours prior to kick-off until one hour after the final whistle.  - Click to access the reporting form At other times, click here to make a report. You can also report it in real time by using our reporting number. During the match text 88777 or 07894 93 77 93, with the stand, row, seat number and description of the offender and incident. All Premier League matches from 17 to 25 October are dedicated to No Room For Racism, reinforcing a collective commitment to tackling all forms of discrimination and promoting diversity within football. With Saturday being our home match during this period, a film will be shown inside Stamford Bridge, celebrating diversity as one of the game's greatest strengths. It will also highlight the impact racism can have on players, their families and communities, and encourages fans to challenge and report discriminatory behaviour. The No Room For Racism message will be displayed throughout the stadium, and players will be taking the knee to show solidarity against discrimination and send a clear message that racism has no place in our game or wider society. Supporters are reminded that engineering work affecting the District Line, with Fulham Broadway Station closed on Saturday, may have an impact on journeys to and from the match. There are also closures on the Circle and Mildmay Lines. The full information with walking routes and a journey planner can be found here.

news.title: Chelsea Football Club announces multi-year sleeve partnership with Sokin
news.title_zh: 切尔西足球俱乐部宣布与索金建立多年袖标合作伙伴关系
news.body_en: Chelsea Football Club can today announce a multi-year partnership with Sokin, the embedded finance and payments company used by businesses worldwide. Sokin will be named a Principal Partner and Official Business Payments and FX Partner of Chelsea FC and Chelsea FC Women. As a Principal Partner, Sokin will be represented on the sleeves of the Chelsea FC men’s, women’s and academy home, away, and third kits from the 2026/27 season. The partnership brings together two ambitious London-headquartered organisations with worldwide reach – a club with millions of fans across the world and a fintech platform through which businesses move more than $11 billion a year. A club of Chelsea’s scale works in many currencies every day, with partners, competitions and supporters around the world, and needs a financial partner built to handle that. Sokin gives finance teams business payments, multi-currency accounts, foreign exchange, checkout and treasury in one place, so they spend less time juggling banks and providers and keep more of what they move. As Official Business Payments and FX Partner, Sokin will simplify how Chelsea FC sends, receives and manages money in the currencies the club operates in. The Sokin logo will feature on the sleeve of the Chelsea shirt for the first time when the men’s team host Tottenham Hotspur at Stamford Bridge on Saturday 24 October. Jason Gannon, President at Chelsea FC, said: 'At Chelsea, we seek to partner with organisations that share our ambition and innovative mindset. Sokin’s expertise in business payments, and their focus on making both simpler for the businesses they serve, makes them a natural fit for the Club. We are pleased to welcome Sokin to the Chelsea family and look forward to working together in the years ahead.' Vroon Modgill, CEO and founder at Sokin, said: 'Chelsea plays on the biggest stage in world football, and its business runs in dozens of currencies. Sokin was built for that with regulated, multi-currency payments and foreign exchange for organisations that operate internationally. 'We’re proud to be the platform behind the business payments and FX of one of the most iconic teams in football. Sokin’s platform serves businesses in more than 170 countries. We’re thrilled to be partners for the season ahead. An organisation as sophisticated as Chelsea doesn’t leave its finances to chance.'
news.body_zh: 切尔西足球俱乐部今天宣布与 Sokin 建立多年合作伙伴关系，Sokin 是一家被全球企业使用的嵌入式金融和支付公司。 Sokin 将被任命为切尔西足球俱乐部和切尔西足球俱乐部女子足球俱乐部的主要合作伙伴以及官方商业支付和外汇合作伙伴。作为主要合作伙伴，索金将出现在切尔西足球俱乐部 2026/27 赛季的男子、女子和青训营主场、客场以及第三套球衣的袖子上。此次合作将两个雄心勃勃、总部位于伦敦、业务遍及全球的组织结合在一起——一个是在全球拥有数百万球迷的俱乐部，另一个是企业每年转移超过 110 亿美元的金融科技平台。切尔西这样规模的俱乐部每天都以多种货币开展业务，与世界各地的合作伙伴、赛事和支持者合作，需要一个能够处理这些问题的金融合作伙伴。 Sokin 为财务团队提供了业务支付、多币种账户、外汇、结帐和金库于一处的服务，因此他们可以减少在银行和提供商之间周旋的时间，并保留更多的流动资金。作为官方商业支付和外汇合作伙伴，Sokin 将简化切尔西足球俱乐部以俱乐部运营货币发送、接收和管理资金的方式。当 10 月 24 日星期六，切尔西男队在斯坦福桥迎战托特纳姆热刺队时，Sokin 徽标将首次出现在切尔西球衣的袖子上。切尔西足球俱乐部主席杰森·甘农 (Jason Gannon) 表示：“在切尔西，我们寻求与与我们拥有共同雄心和创新思维的组织合作。 Sokin 在商业支付方面的专业知识，以及他们致力于让他们所服务的企业变得更简单，使他们成为俱乐部的天然人选。我们很高兴欢迎索金加入切尔西大家庭，并期待在未来的岁月里共同努力。” Sokin 首席执行官兼创始人 Vroon Modgill 表示：“切尔西在世界足球最大的舞台上踢球，其业务以数十种货币运行。 Sokin 专为国际运营组织提供受监管的多币种支付和外汇而构建。 “我们很自豪能够成为足球界最具标志性的球队之一的商业支付和外汇背后的平台。 Sokin 的平台为 170 多个国家的企业提供服务。我们很高兴能成为下一季的合作伙伴。像切尔西这样复杂的组织不会让其财务状况听天由命。”

news.title: Alonso targeting a ‘complete’ performance to continue good run

news.body_en: Tottenham Hotspur's visit to Stamford Bridge tomorrow is the first of three high-profile fixtures in the space of the week for Xabi Alonso's side – and the Blues manager has stressed the qualities that must be shown to start with a positive result. We have lost to the side from north London just once in our past 41 meetings in SW6, but Alonso knows that record counts for nothing come kick-off on Saturday, when a new chapter in the rivalry will be written. With the Blues targeting a third straight league success for the first time since the start of this year, and Tottenham hoping to pick up a second victory this week, there is plenty on the line. Alonso knows what to expect. ‘We need to have a very complete game,’ he said. ‘Offensively, defensively, mentality-wise going through difficult moments, as there will be moments for everything. ‘We need to prove again we can continue our run, knowing it’s a special game. We need to play with our head, heart, with intelligence but with passionate energy. We will need many things tomorrow.’ On Tottenham, Alonso added: ‘I’ve seen a good team even in bad results, so we’re expecting a tough game against good opposition who do many good things. 'We need to be prepared for what to do in different moments with the ball. It’s going to be game eight [in the Premier League this season], so it’s still early days for everything.’ The meeting with Tottenham is the first of three high-profile fixtures in quick succession. Next week we travel to Liverpool in the Carabao Cup fourth round before hosting Manchester United. Alonso is excited for what is to come, and wants to see his side rise to the challenge and prove their credentials. ‘It was a matter of time until we had big games and this week we have three massive games against top clubs. This happens in the Premier League; this is not news. So we take it step by step, and we start tomorrow.’ Don't miss your chance to experience the London derby in VIP style. Limited Club Chelsea tickets remain – book now to be at the Bridge.
news.body_zh: 托特纳姆热刺队明天做客斯坦福桥是哈维·阿隆索球队本周三场备受瞩目的比赛中的第一场——蓝军主帅强调了必须展现出的品质才能取得积极的结果。在过去 41 场 SW6 比赛中，我们只输给了来自北伦敦的球队一次，但阿隆索知道，周六开赛时，纪录没有任何意义，届时比赛将谱写新的篇章。蓝军的目标是自今年年初以来首次取得联赛三连胜，而托特纳姆热刺则希望在本周取得第二场胜利，因此有很多机会。阿隆索知道会发生什么。 “我们需要一场非常完整的比赛，”他说。 “在进攻、防守、心态上都要经历困难时刻，因为一切都会有时刻。 “我们需要再次证明我们可以继续我们的比赛，因为我们知道这是一场特殊的比赛。我们需要用我们的头脑、心灵、智慧和热情来玩耍。明天我们需要很多东西。”在托特纳姆热刺队中，阿隆索补充道：“我见过一支优秀的球队，即使成绩很差，所以我们期待一场艰难的比赛，对手是出色的对手，他们做了很多好事。” “我们需要为不同时刻拿球时该做什么做好准备。这将是（本赛季英超联赛）的第八场比赛，所以一切都还为时尚早。”与托特纳姆热刺队的比赛是连续三场备受瞩目的比赛中的第一场。下周我们将前往利物浦参加卡拉宝杯第四轮比赛，然后主场迎战曼联。阿隆索对即将发生的事情感到兴奋，并希望看到他的球队迎接挑战并证明他们的实力。 “我们迟早会举行大型比赛，本周我们将与顶级俱乐部进行三场大型比赛。这种情况发生在英超联赛中；这不是新闻。所以我们一步一步来，明天开始。” 不要错过以 VIP 方式体验伦敦德比的机会。切尔西俱乐部门票数量有限——立即预订即可在桥上购买。

news.title: Ticketing update
news.title_zh: 票务更新
news.body_en: As part of our commitment to provide transparency for our supporters across our ticketing policies and procedures, Chelsea FC is pleased to share an update on the progress of the newly introduced systems so far this season. The ticket application window was introduced for men's team matches for the 2026/27 season following supporter feedback regarding the ticketing process. After extensive fan consultation with multiple fan groups, the Fan Advisory Board and a supporter town hall, the ticket application window has been established to streamline the ticket purchase journey, make it fairer and more accessible for genuine Chelsea fans to purchase tickets, and reduce the risk of bot and tout activity. Similar systems are operated by a number of other Premier League clubs. We are pleased to share the results of the first six ticket application windows this season, to update supporters on how the process is working. Based on the data available for the ticket application windows this season, an eligible member applying for an individual match ticket via the ticket application window stood a 68% chance of securing a ticket. Overall, 99% of eligible members who applied for every Premier League game, have successfully secured at least one ticket, via the ticket application window, the ticket exchange or ticket forwarding, demonstrating the system provides greater opportunity for a larger number of fans to attend matches at Stamford Bridge. So far this season, of all fans who have applied in at least one ticket application window, 80% have secured a ticket for at least one match. The most in-demand fixtures are sold using a loyalty point threshold, to prioritise loyalty and regular match-going supporters. For the Manchester United and Tottenham Hotspur fixtures, 46% of tickets were allocated to those who fell within the top 10% of total accumulated loyalty points. The ticket exchange and ticket forwarding function provides an additional route for supporters to access tickets. For those who were unsuccessful in the ticket application window, the ticket exchange represents a second chance of securing a ticket, with unsuccessful applicants having a minimum 48-hour priority window. We want to ensure genuine Chelsea fans are able to access tickets and we encourage all our supporters to use the ticket exchange and ticket forwarding to do so. For more information on using these mechanisms,  you can view our How-to Guides by clicking here. We also want to ensure that the next generation of Chelsea supporters have more opportunity to come to Stamford Bridge. So far this season, 76% of Junior Blue members who have applied in the ticket application window have been successful in securing at least one match ticket. The club continues to clamp down on ticket touting. In previous seasons, we have seen up to 80,000 bots per game attempt to access tickets online. Now, with the introduction of the ticket application window those using automated purchasing software are prevented from accessing on-sale windows and it enables increased monitoring of accounts to identify suspicious activity. We also continue to operate ticket collection points at home and away fixtures. So far this season, we have seen a 93% non-collection rate, demonstrating that our ongoing work to identify suspicious or fraudulent accounts is working. Using this data and supporter feedback, the club will continue to review our ticketing policies and processes, sharing regular insights with the Fan Advisory Board and updating Fans’ Forums.
news.body_zh: 作为我们致力于为球迷提供票务政策和程序透明度的承诺的一部分，切尔西足球俱乐部很高兴分享本赛季迄今为止新引入的系统的最新进展。根据球迷对票务流程的反馈，2026/27 赛季男子团体比赛引入了门票申请窗口。经过与多个球迷团体、球迷咨询委员会和支持者市政厅进行广泛的球迷咨询后，设立了门票申请窗口，以简化门票购买流程，让真正的切尔西球迷更公平、更容易地购买门票，并降低机器人和兜售活动的风险。许多其他英超俱乐部也运营类似的系统。我们很高兴分享本赛季前六个门票申请窗口的结果，以便支持者了解该流程的最新情况。根据本赛季门票申请窗口的数据，符合资格的会员通过门票申请窗口申请个人比赛门票的机会为 68%。总体而言，申请每场英超比赛的合格会员中有99%通过门票申请窗口、门票交换或门票转发成功获得至少一张门票，这表明该系统为更多球迷观看斯坦福桥比赛提供了更多机会。本赛季到目前为止，在至少一个门票申请窗口申请过的所有球迷中，80% 的人已经获得了至少一场比赛的门票。最受欢迎的比赛按照忠诚度积分阈值进行出售，以优先考虑忠诚度和定期参加比赛的支持者。对于曼联和托特纳姆热刺队的比赛，46% 的门票分配给了累计忠诚度积分排名前 10% 的会员。门票兑换和门票转发功能为支持者获取门票提供了额外的途径。对于那些在门票申请窗口中未成功申请的人来说，换票是获得门票的第二次机会，未成功的申请人有至少 48 小时的优先窗口。我们希望确保真正的切尔西球迷能够获得门票，并鼓励所有支持者使用门票交换和门票转发来获得门票。有关使用这些机制的更多信息，您可以单击此处查看我们的操作指南。我们还希望确保下一代切尔西球迷有更多机会来到斯坦福桥。本赛季到目前为止，在门票申请窗口申请的 Junior Blue 会员中有 76% 成功获得了至少一张比赛门票。俱乐部继续打击倒卖门票行为。在前几个赛季中，我们发现每场比赛有多达 80,000 个机器人尝试在线获取门票。现在，随着门票申请窗口的引入，那些使用自动购买软件的人将无法访问销售窗口，并且可以加强对帐户的监控以识别可疑活动。我们还继续运营主场和客场比赛的售票点。本季度到目前为止，我们的未收款率为 93%，这表明我们正在进行的识别可疑或欺诈账户的工作正在发挥作用。利用这些数据和支持者的反馈，俱乐部将继续审查我们的票务政策和流程，与球迷咨询委员会定期分享见解并更新球迷论坛。

news.title: Xabi Alonso says Mike Penders is ready to show his qualities
news.title_zh: 哈比·阿隆索表示迈克·彭德斯已准备好展示他的品质
news.body_en: Mike Penders is expected to start his first Premier League game when Chelsea meet Tottenham tomorrow, and Xabi Alonso is confident the 21-year-old is prepared for the challenge that awaits. Penders was introduced midway through the second half of our victory at Everton last weekend, becoming our youngest Premier League goalkeeper. He replaced Emi Martinez, who took a heavy blow to the face and has subsequently undergone surgery on his jaw. With Martinez out for what Alonso says will be a ‘few weeks’, Penders is set to don the gloves for the Blues, with a mouthwatering London derby up first. ‘He is ready,’ said Alonso in his pre-match press conference. ‘He has been training well and played a couple of cup games where he showed he has a good level. Even the other day when he came on against Everton, he showed in a few minutes his personality and qualities. ‘This is why we have a squad, to be ready for these kinds of situations, and we are fully convinced that Mike can play very well. He is a goalkeeper for now and for the future. We are looking to the next games and are happy with Mike. He is prepared.’ Penders’ assimilation into English football has been aided in the past couple of months by Martinez, who brings a vast wealth of knowledge and know-how with him. Alonso explained how the Argentinean has helped Penders, who spent last season on loan at Strasbourg having signed for Chelsea in the summer of 2024. ‘He has the support and is learning from an experienced goalkeeper in Emi, who is having a great impact on the team and on Mike. ‘That happens in a very natural way. It’s not that we say, “Dibu, you have to be a mentor and you have this certificate.” It happens naturally, spontaneously every day because Emi likes to talk, not just with the other goalkeepers, but defenders as well. ‘He is very communicative and he likes to have this sense that they are close. So it’s happening.’ 'It has been noted that Penders bears similarities to former Chelsea goalkeeper Thibaut Courtois, who Alonso worked with at Real Madrid. Our manager agrees there are resemblances between the two beyond simply their appearance and nationality. ‘The stature, both left-footed, both dominant in the air,’ Alonso pointed out. ‘I spoke with Thibaut when he was at the World Cup and asked about Mike, and he said himself that he could see the resemblance with Mike. 'We need to help him, support him, but for sure he is a goalkeeper for the present and the future.’ Don't miss your chance to experience the London derby in VIP style. Limited Club Chelsea tickets remain – book now to be at the Bridge.
news.body_zh: 迈克·潘德斯预计将在明天切尔西对阵托特纳姆热刺时首发他的首场英超比赛，哈维·阿隆索相信这位 21 岁的球员已经为即将到来的挑战做好了准备。上周末我们战胜埃弗顿的比赛下半场中段，潘德斯登场，成为我们最年轻的英超门将。他接替了埃米·马丁内斯，后者脸部受到重击，随后下巴接受了手术。阿隆索表示，马丁内斯将缺席“几周”，潘德斯将为蓝军戴上手套，首先将进行一场令人垂涎的伦敦德比。 “他已经准备好了，”阿隆索在赛前新闻发布会上说道。 “他训练得很好，参加了几场杯赛，证明了自己的水平很高。即使在前几天对阵埃弗顿的比赛中，他也能在几分钟内展现出自己的个性和品质。 “这就是为什么我们有一支球队，为这种情况做好准备，我们完全相信迈克可以打得很好。他是现在和未来的守门员。我们正在期待接下来的比赛，并对迈克感到满意。他已经做好了准备。过去几个月，马丁内斯帮助彭德斯融入了英国足球，马丁内斯带来了丰富的知识和技巧。阿隆索解释了阿根廷人如何帮助潘德斯，潘德斯上赛季被租借到斯特拉斯堡，并于 2024 年夏天签约切尔西。 ‘这以一种非常自然的方式发生。我们并不是说，“迪布，你必须成为一名导师，并且你有这个证书。”这种事情每天都会自然而然地发生，因为埃米不仅喜欢与其他守门员交谈，还喜欢与后卫交谈。 “他非常善于沟通，他喜欢有一种他们很亲密的感觉。 “人们注意到，潘德斯与阿隆索在皇家马德里共事过的前切尔西门将蒂博·库尔图瓦有相似之处。”我们的经理同意，除了外表和国籍之外，两人之间还存在相似之处。 “身材，都是左脚，都在空中占主导地位，”阿隆索指出。 “当蒂博参加世界杯时，我与他交谈并询问了迈克的情况，他自己说他可以看到与迈克的相似之处。 “我们需要帮助他，支持他，但可以肯定的是，他是现在和未来的门将。” 不要错过以 VIP 方式体验伦敦德比的机会。切尔西俱乐部门票数量有限——立即预订即可在桥上购买。

news.title: Xabi Alonso confirms Chelsea team news for Tottenham
news.title_zh: 哈比·阿隆索确认了切尔西队为托特纳姆热刺队的消息
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso confirmed Blues defender Malo Gusto is in contention to face Tottenham Hotspur tomorrow and provided updates on the fitness of Pep Chavarria, Emmanuel Emegha and Emi Martinez. The Blues welcome an old foe to Stamford Bridge tomorrow afternoon as Roberto De Zerbi brings his Spurs side to west London. We enter the game after impressive back-to-back top-flight victories: the first a 5-1 win over Bournemouth and the second a 2-0 triumph at Everton. Tottenham, meanwhile, recorded their first Premier League win of the campaign last time out. However, they are winless on the road this season. Alonso, who undertook his pre-match press conference duties after today's training session at Cobham, confirmed that Gusto was fit to return after missing our win on Merseyside last weekend. Chavarria, though, will remain absent. 'Malo is fine,' the Blues manager explained. 'Pep is training a little bit more, but he is not going to make it [for the Tottenham game]. Emegha will also miss out. The striker has yet to feature since arriving this summer, but is making progress in his comeback. ‘He’s feeling better, but we need to wait,' said Alonso. There will be no Martinez against Tottenham – or for a few weeks – due to the injury the Argentine sustained against Everton in a collision with Jarrad Branthwaite. Martinez was stretchered off in the second half and was taken to hospital for further checks, after which he underwent surgery on his jaw. Alonso confirmed the goalkeeper is doing well, but he will be sidelined for the matches ahead. 'Emi is doing better,' he said. 'He had the surgery and day by day he is feeling better, but we still need to wait. A few weeks. Hopefully, less than more, but we need to wait. 'The good thing is that he is feeling better and we need to listen to his feelings, the opinions of the doctors, the specialists, the surgeons. Considering it was a bad one, he is doing good.' Don't miss your chance to experience the London derby in VIP style. Limited Club Chelsea tickets remain – book now to be at the Bridge.

news.title: Lexi Potter on learnings from Keira Walsh and facing her former side

news.body_en: If there ever was an ideal role model for a young midfielder in the women’s game, it would be serial winner Keira Walsh. Our Chelsea Academy graduate Lexi Potter is now learning alongside her in the Blues first team, and she is thriving. It’s more than just master and apprentice, though. Potter’s calm head and confidence on the ball in the holding role has allowed Walsh to play higher up the pitch, to great success. When we sat down with the 20-year-old prodigy, she gave some insight into how the pair work together, and also into the general mood inside the camp at Chelsea. ‘Keira gives me a lot of confidence when I’m playing alongside her,’ Potter told us. ‘Especially when I'm receiving the ball out of possession. She gives me a lot of good information. We see the game in a similar way, and we're on the same page a lot of the time when we’re trying to progress the ball forward from a central area. ‘We’re in a really nice place as a team. For a while now, it's been really positive, and I think you can see it in the performances that everyone's working and fighting for each other.’ This Sunday, we face newly-promoted Crystal Palace away from home. Potter is best qualified to talk about the Eagles, having helped them earn promotion to the Women’s Super League in 2023/24. She immediately returned for a second season-long loan, gaining valuable experience in the WSL. Now, they are back in the top flight and the midfielder passes along some insight on what to expect from them. ‘I think it'll be a good game,’ she says. 'Having been at the club for two seasons, I know a few of the girls, and I’m looking forward to the game. ‘It was really special to be involved in their promotion. It was my first year in senior football, and I really enjoyed that season. I had a lot of opportunities, which I was grateful for. It was a really good season, and I  enjoyed it. ‘I was only 17, so I wasn't allowed to go for the full celebrations. But yeah, they were good; they were fun. It was a nice end to a good season. ‘The second season was a slightly different season to the first one. It was obviously a lot harder teams that we played. In terms of competition for places, it was a lot harder, and it was a different mindset. Potter added: ‘Getting minutes in the WSL at Palace really helped me because playing time is so valuable when you are developing. That exposure to the WSL really helped me during the loan. ‘When you’re a newly-promoted side, playing against the big teams was a really big challenge, and that’s always good for long-term development. I'm still in touch with a couple of the girls. I know Aimee (Everett), the captain, quite well and I speak to her fairly regularly. She really looked after me when I was there. ‘A few of the staff members there were really like impactful and really beneficial for me and my journey. I'm very lucky to have crossed paths with a lot of good people at the club. ‘They've had a good start to the season. They've picked up some really good results, so they'll put up a good challenge. They'll defend well, and we need to be on our game and try and break them down.’ Having now cemented her place in the Blues first team, our discussion concluded with our question about what she would say to any young players in the Chelsea Academy who are hoping to follow in her footsteps. ‘I'd say work hard and be patient,’ she concluded. ‘Your time will come. You just have to stay ready and work hard for it.’
news.body_zh: 如果女足比赛中的年轻中场球员有一个理想的榜样，那就是连续冠军凯拉·沃尔什。我们的切尔西学院毕业生莱克西·波特现在正在蓝军一线队与她一起学习，她正在蓬勃发展。不过，这不仅仅是师徒关系。波特冷静的头脑和控球的信心让沃尔什能够在球场上踢得更高，并取得了巨大的成功。当我们与这位 20 岁的天才坐下来交谈时，她对两人如何合作以及切尔西训练营内的总体气氛进行了一些深入的了解。 “当我和凯拉一起打球时，凯拉给了我很大的信心，”波特告诉我们。 “尤其是当我在失控状态下接球时。她给了我很多有用的信息。我们以类似的方式看待比赛，当我们试图从中心区域向前推进球时，我们很多时候都在同一页面上。 “作为一个团队，我们处于一个非常好的位置。一段时间以来，情况确实很积极，我想你可以从每个人的表现中看到这一点，每个人都在为彼此努力和奋斗。”本周日，我们将在客场迎战升班马水晶宫。波特最有资格谈论老鹰队，她帮助他们在 2023/24 赛季晋升到女子超级联赛。她立即​​回归，获得了第二个赛季的租借，在 WSL 中获得了宝贵的经验。现在，他们回到了顶级联赛，这位中场球员分享了一些关于他们的期望的见解。 “我认为这将是一场精彩的比赛，”她说。 “在俱乐部呆了两个赛季，我认识一些女孩，我很期待这场比赛。 “参与他们的促销活动真的很特别。这是我参加成年足球比赛的第一年，我真的很喜欢那个赛季。我有很多机会，我很感激。那真是一个美好的赛季，我很享受。 “我当时只有 17 岁，所以我不被允许参加完整的庆祝活动。但是，是的，他们很好；他们很有趣。这是一个美好赛季的美好结局。 “第二季与第一季略有不同。显然我们对阵的球队要困难得多。就名额竞争而言，难度更大，心态也不同。波特补充道：“在水晶宫的 WSL 中获得上场时间确实对我很有帮助，因为当你在进步时，上场时间非常宝贵。在贷款期间接触 WSL 确实对我有帮助。 “当你是一支新晋级球队时，与强队比赛是一个非常大的挑战，这对于长期发展总是有好处的。我仍然和几个女孩保持着联系。我很了解船长艾米（埃弗雷特饰），我也经常和她交谈。当我在那里时，她真的很照顾我。 “那里的一些工作人员确实很有影响力，对我和我的旅程非常有益。我很幸运能够在俱乐部遇到很多优秀的人。 ‘他们本赛季有一个良好的开局。他们已经取得了一些非常好的成绩，所以他们将提出很好的挑战。他们会防守得很好，我们需要在比赛中努力击败他们。”现在巩固了她在蓝军一线队的地位，我们的讨论最后提出了这样的问题：她会对切尔西青训营中任何希望追随她脚步的年轻球员说些什么。 “我想说的是努力工作并保持耐心，”她总结道。 ‘你的时刻将会到来。你只需要做好准备并为之努力。”

news.title: Freddy Bernal signs new deal
news.title_zh: 弗雷迪·伯纳尔签署新合同
news.body_en: Chelsea Football Club is pleased to announce that Cobham Next Gen goalkeeper Freddy Bernal has signed a new contract, keeping him at the club until at least June 2029. Having joined Chelsea’s Academy as an Under-8, Bernal became a full-time scholar in 2025/26 and established himself for the Under-18s, winning the Under-18s Premier League title at Stamford Bridge. Bernal has since become a consistent presence between the sticks for Cobham Next Gen, making eight appearances so far and keeping a clean sheet in our latest EFL Trophy clash against Reading. The 18-year-old also gained valuable European experience last season in the UEFA Youth League, producing some standout performances against Bayern Munich, Benfica and Ajax. A reliable presence in goal, Bernal has demonstrated maturity throughout his progression at Chelsea. His form has also been recognised internationally with regular invitations to England youth camps. Having previously represented the Young Lions at Under-17 and Under-18 level, he featured for the Under-19s during the September and October international window.
news.body_zh: 切尔西足球俱乐部很高兴地宣布，科巴姆下一代门将弗雷迪·贝尔纳尔已签署了一份新合同，他将在俱乐部效力至少到 2029 年 6 月。贝尔纳尔作为 8 岁以下球员加入切尔西青训学院后，于 2025/26 赛季成为一名全职学者，并在 18 岁以下队中确立了自己的地位，并在斯坦福桥赢得了 18 岁以下队英超联赛冠军。此后，伯纳尔成为科巴姆下一代球队的稳定主力，迄今为止已出场八次，并在我们最近对阵雷丁的英格兰足球联赛杯比赛中保持不失球。这位18岁的球员上赛季还在青年欧联中获得了宝贵的欧洲经验，在对阵拜仁慕尼黑、本菲卡和阿贾克斯的比赛中都有出色的表现。伯纳尔在进球方面表现出色，在切尔西的整个成长过程中都表现出了成熟的一面。他的表现也得到了国际认可，定期受邀参加英格兰青年训练营。他此前曾代表幼狮队参加 17 岁以下和 18 岁以下级别的比赛，并在 9 月和 10 月的国际比赛期间代表 19 岁以下队出场。

news.title: FPL 2026/27: Chelsea Gameweek eight
news.title_zh: FPL 2026/27：切尔西第八周比赛
news.body_en: Chelsea have teamed up with Fantasy Football Scout to help bring you hints, tips and advice during the 2026/27 Fantasy Premier League (FPL) season. Scout will be using their expertise to provide advice and gameweek tips which should prove useful in ensuring you win your mini-leagues. Here, we look at which Blues players are the best value-for-money picks, why Morgan Rogers (£8.0m) is Chelsea’s most popular player this week and who you should captain in Gameweek 8. The deadline is 6.30pm BST on Friday ahead of Nottingham Forest’s trip to Ipswich Town. Morgan Rogers (£8.0m) is the most popular Chelsea player ahead of Gameweek 8 with over 170,000 transfers in. The Englishman has risen in price to £8.0m after starting the season at £7.5m and is the most-selected midfielder in Fantasy, with an ownership of over 48%. No Chelsea player has registered more expected goal involvement (xGI) than Rogers’ tally of 3.43; on top of that, he has notched 19 shots and created an impressive 13 chances. In an Aston Villa shirt, Rogers picked up three attacking returns in four starts against Spurs. Also proving popular is Pedro Neto (£6.5m) following his 15-point return last time out. The Portugal international scored twice and notched maximum bonus points. He was the highest-scoring player in the game in GW7. Neto has had four big chances, putting him second among all Blues players. Over 130,000 managers have purchased the right-wing back. With Bukayo Saka flagged as an injury doubt, Cole Palmer (£9.7m) will no doubt be in demand as the deadline approaches. The Chelsea number 10 is averaging just under six points per match in 26/27 and is yet to blank at Stamford Bridge, picking up a goal and three assists at home. Josh Acheampong (£4.5m) has started each of the last two Gameweeks and played his part in the Blues’ first clean sheet of the season. The England under-21 international picked up defensive contribution points against Everton, the second time he has reached the threshold in four starts. At just £4.5m, Acheampong has the potential to provide very good value in your FPL defence. In goal, Mike Penders (£4.4m) looks set to start with Emi Martinez (£5.0m) undergoing surgery for a fractured jaw. If selected, the Belgian will be the cheapest starting goalkeeper in the entire game. Spurs have scored just once in three away matches so far this season. Outside of Chelsea players, Erling Haaland (£15.7m) is a reliable captaincy option for Man City’s Saturday lunchtime trip to Aston Villa. The Norwegian has scored in six consecutive Gameweeks with eight goals, two double-digit hauls, 12 bonus points and 56 Fantasy points in that time. Haaland has been passed fit in the pre-Gameweek press conference. No player has had more shots on target or xGI than the league’s top scorer. Elsewhere, Morgan Gibbs-White (£7.9m) is an intriguing, differential option against Ipswich Town. Oliver Glasner confirmed in his press conference on Wednesday that the Nottingham Forest talisman is fit and available after missing GW7 with a knock. No player has created more big chances than Gibbs-White (7), who has picked up three attacking returns in three away matches. Opponents Ipswich are yet to keep a clean sheet so far this season.

news.title: Morgan Rogers on bringing creativity, a ‘different’ front three and ageless Henderson
news.title_zh: 摩根·罗杰斯谈带来创造力、“不同”的前三名和永恒的亨德森
news.body_en: When Morgan Rogers gets the ball at his feet, there is only one thing on his mind. ‘The quickest way we can create a chance, whatever that may look like.’ That philosophy has served our No.17 superbly since his arrival at Stamford Bridge this summer. Rogers has had a telling impact in Xabi Alonso’s attack, providing four goals and four assists in his nine appearances to date. He has seamlessly adapted to life at Chelsea and has formed a potent partnership with Joao Pedro and his great mate Cole Palmer. Part of the reason it has been so successful is because of Rogers’ desire to make things happen. ‘I always want to be creative,’ he explains. ‘I always want to attack the goal and be threatening. Even if it doesn't work, even if it doesn't come off, I know I want the defenders thinking that I've got the ability to try something or something's going to happen here. ‘That's the way I've always been since I was younger. I think if someone is watching me, I'd want them to feel excited about watching the game and watching me play. ‘So I try and do everything I can in the little time or whatever time I've got on the ball, and just try and make as much of a difference as possible.’ Rogers has been aided by having his pal Palmer alongside him, as well as a striker at the top of his game in Joao Pedro. Between the three, 13 goals and ten assists have already been registered. That is some return just nine games into the campaign, and Rogers believes it is the variety of assets they bring that opponents have such difficulty dealing with. ‘A lot of it is chemistry, and I think we attack and challenge defenders in completely different ways,’ says Rogers. ‘We all want the ball in different ways. We all want different things in the game, and if they try and stop one, then the other two are going to get their joy because we're all so different. ‘If you get people that are the same and want the same, once you cut that off, you're struggling. But because we all want different things, if you try to stop Cole, then it allows me and Joao more space. If you try to stop me and Joao, then Cole's going to be free as a bird to set his authority on the game. ‘It’s kind of a mismatch for other teams of what to stop and how to stop it. We know that if we're all on it and we're all in the positive mindset of helping each other, that we're all going to get joy from the game.’ It is not only our attacking players that have caught the eye so far in 2026/27. Alonso has highlighted the importance of the collective in helping us become more robust defensively, and the addition of Jordan Henderson to our midfield in recent weeks has proven beneficial in that respect. Henderson, an England team-mate of Rogers’, covered more distance than anyone else on the pitch in our impressive recent victories over Bournemouth and Everton. His performances in a Chelsea shirt have come as no surprise to Rogers. ‘He's a special person, and a special player. People forget the player and just remember the person. They think he's here for experience and to help everyone, but people forget the player and what he's achieved in the game. ‘He can still play at the highest level. He can still outrun everyone. He’s so driven and he’s in such good shape. Thirty-six doesn’t mean anything to him, because he can still compete with 23- and 24-year-olds as he shows in training every day. ‘There’s no surprise to me that he can still impact games and impact teams because of his mentality, the way he thinks about the game, and the way he thinks about his body. 'Even if he's not at the training ground, he's thinking constantly about how he can be in the best physical and mental shape come the weekend to perform and deliver. ‘The more people talk about his age, the more fire it gives him to prove people wrong. So people need to keep calling him old and saying he's finished, because then he'll just keep getting better!’
news.body_zh: 当摩根·罗杰斯把球拿到脚下时，他脑子里只有一件事。 “无论是什么样的机会，我们都能以最快的方式创造机会。”自从今年夏天他来到斯坦福桥以来，这种理念一直为我们的 17 号球员提供了极好的服务。罗杰斯对哈维·阿隆索的进攻产生了显着的影响，迄今为止在他的九场比赛中贡献了四个进球和四次助攻。他已经无缝地适应了切尔西的生活，并与若昂·佩德罗和他的伟大队友科尔·帕尔默建立了强有力的合作伙伴关系。它如此成功的部分原因是罗杰斯渴望让事情发生。 “我总是想发挥创造力，”他解释道。 “我总是想攻击球门并具有威胁性。即使它不起作用，即使它没有成功，我知道我希望防守者认为我有能力尝试一些事情或这里会发生一些事情。 ‘从我年轻的时候起，我就一直这样。我想如果有人在观看我，我希望他们对观看比赛和观看我的比赛感到兴奋。 “所以我会尽我所能，在很短的时间内或任何我有球的时间里，尽可能地发挥作用。”罗杰斯得到了他的朋友帕尔默和他的最佳前锋若昂·佩德罗的帮助。三人之间已经打入 13 粒进球和 10 次助攻。这是赛季刚开始九场比赛就取得的回报，罗杰斯相信，正是他们带来的各种资产让对手难以应对。 “这很大程度上是化学反应，我认为我们以完全不同的方式攻击和挑战防守者，”罗杰斯说。 “我们都以不同的方式想要球。我们都想在游戏中得到不同的东西，如果他们试图阻止其中一个，那么其他两个就会得到他们的快乐，因为我们都是如此不同。 “如果你得到的人都是一样的，想要的也一样，一旦你切断了这一点，你就会陷入困境。但因为我们都想要不同的东西，如果你试图阻止科尔，那么它会给我和若奥更多的空间。如果你试图阻止我和若昂，那么科尔就会像小鸟一样自由地在比赛中树立自己的权威。 “对于其他球队来说，这在阻止什么以及如何阻止方面有点不匹配。我们知道，如果我们都全力以赴，并且都抱着互相帮助的积极心态，那么我们都会从比赛中获得快乐。” 2026/27 赛季到目前为止，吸引眼球的不仅仅是我们的进攻球员。阿隆索强调了集体对于帮助我们变得更加强大的防守的重要性，最近几周乔丹·亨德森加入我们的中场已经证明在这方面是有益的。罗杰斯的英格兰队友亨德森在我们最近战胜伯恩茅斯和埃弗顿的比赛中，跑动的距离比场上任何人都远。罗杰斯对他身披切尔西球衣的表现并不感到意外。 ‘他是一个特别的人，也是一个特别的球员。人们忘记了球员，只记住了这个人。他们认为他来这里是为了积累经验并帮助每个人，但人们忘记了球员以及他在比赛中取得的成就。 ‘他仍然可以发挥最高水平。他仍然可以超越所有人。他动力十足，而且状态很好。三十六岁对他来说并不意味着什么，因为他仍然可以与23岁和24岁的人竞争，正如他每天在训练中所表现的那样。 “他仍然能够影响比赛和球队，这对我来说并不奇怪，因为他的心态、他对比赛的看法以及他对自己身体的看法。 “即使他不在训练场上，他也会不断思考如何在周末保持最佳的身体和精神状态来表现和交付。 “人们越多谈论他的年龄，他就越想证明人们是错的。”所以人们需要继续称他老了，并说他已经完蛋了，因为那样他就会不断变得更好！

news.body_en: The highlight of a fantastic 4-0 win over Manchester United exactly a decade ago was N'Golo Kante's first Chelsea goal. The Blues were already three goals to the good - courtesy of Pedro, Gary Cahill and Eden Hazard - when Kante danced between a static defence and coolly slotted his finish into the bottom corner. The goal was met with a huge roar inside Stamford Bridge, with the loveable Kante mobbed by his team-mates after opening his Chelsea account a few months into what turned out to be a glittering Blues career. Although best known for his work winning possession back and foiling the opposition, Kante was also an excellent finisher, and this goal showcased his preference for placement over power. In total, the French World Cup winner scored 13 times in 269 Chelsea appearances. This was one of the most memorable, and you can watch the highlights of a fantastic victory at the Bridge below!
news.body_zh: 整整十年前，恩戈洛·坎特在切尔西 4-0 战胜曼联的比赛中打进了第一个进球。在佩德罗、加里·卡希尔和伊登·阿扎尔的帮助下，蓝军已经领先三球，坎特在静止的防守中起舞，冷静地将射门打入球门底角。这个进球在斯坦福桥球场内引起了巨大的轰动，可爱的坎特在开启他的切尔西账户几个月后就被他的队友围攻，而他的蓝军生涯才刚刚开始。尽管坎特以夺回控球权和挫败对手而闻名，但他也是一名出色的终结者，这个进球展示了他对位置而非力量的偏好。这位法国世界杯冠军在为切尔西出场的 269 场比赛中总共打入 13 球。这是最令人难忘的一场比赛，您可以在下面的桥上观看精彩胜利的精彩片段！

news.body_en: It is derby day at Stamford Bridge on Saturday when Chelsea host capital rivals Tottenham Hotspur in west London. Here are all the key facts and figures you need ahead of kick-off. Chelsea go into our eighth Premier League match of the season having moved up to fourth place in the table. We are one point ahead of Liverpool in fifth. Saturday’s opponents Spurs are in 16th, with one win and three draws so far. Chelsea have won our last six Premier League games against Spurs and are aiming for a seventh straight league win for the first time in our history. Chelsea are unbeaten in our past 10 Premier League meetings with Tottenham when scoring first (nine wins, one draw). The Blues have won more games in all competitions against Tottenham than we have against any other club (83). We have scored 124 goals in 68 Premier League games against Tottenham, more than against any other opponent. Since 1990, Chelsea have lost just once in 41 home matches against Tottenham in all competitions, winning 27 and drawing 13. That sole defeat came in April 2018. Tottenham have won one of their past 15 Premier League games against Chelsea (with two draws, 12 defeats), a 2-0 home win in February 2023. In last season’s corresponding fixture in May, Enzo Fernandez and Andrey Santos gave us a two-goal lead, before Richarlison pulled one back for Spurs in the 74th minute. It ended 2-1.
